journey.name: Queue Management and Reordering
journey.description: Verifies adding multiple episodes to the queue, starting playback, rearranging the queue order, and verifying that the next episode that plays matches the new queue order upon completion.

actions.action: Tap on "Explore" in the bottom navigation bar.
Tap on the first podcast in the explore list to view its episodes.
Tap the "Add to queue" button on three consecutive episodes to build a queue of multiple episodes.
Tap on "Library" in the bottom navigation bar and select "Queue".
Verify that the queued episodes are visible in the queue list.
Tap the "Play" button on the first episode in the queue to begin playback.
Drag the reorder handle of an episode in the queue to rearrange the playback order.
Note the title of the next episode now positioned immediately following the playing episode.
Tap on the mini-player bar at the bottom to expand the full player screen.
Drag or tap the playback seekbar near the very end of the episode so only a few seconds remain.
Wait for the current episode to finish playback.
Verify that playback transitions to the newly reordered next episode from the queue.
